test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 06 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A man has to cover a distance of 753 km in 12 hours. If he covers two-thirds of the distance in 2/3 of the time, then what should his speed (in km/hr) be to cover the remaining distance in the remaining time left ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Remaining distance fraction = 1 − 2/3 = **1/3**

Remaining time fraction = 1 − 2/3 = **1/3**

Required speed = (Total Distance × 1/3) ÷ (Total Time × 1/3) = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

Required speed = 753 ÷ 12 = **62.75 km/hr**

**∴ The correct answer is 62.75 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/acff430fe61ca91b430df002058773ea7e8196aad77d0066256a483e2efa0d26.png] 

**Given:**

Total Distance = **753 km**

Total Time = **12 hours**

**Calculations:**

⇒ Distance covered = 2/3 × 753 = **502 km**

⇒ Remaining distance = 753 − 502 = **251 km**

⇒ Time taken = 2/3 × 12 = **8 hours**

⇒ Remaining time = 12 − 8 = **4 hours**

⇒ Required Speed = Remaining Distance ÷ Remaining Time

⇒ Required Speed = 251 ÷ 4 = **62.75 km/hr**

**∴ The correct answer is 62.75 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Basic Speed Formula

Speed is defined as the distance covered per unit time. Formula: Speed = Distance ÷ Time.

Unit Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.

Average Speed

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time. If distances are equal, Avg Speed = 2xy/(x+y).</p
